projectDescription: A static analyzer for LLM prompts that catches security risks, token waste, and quality issues — like ESLint, but for AI prompt text.
keyFeatures: Prompt injection and jailbreak detection with leetspeak/unicode normalization
PII and secret/credential scanning in prompts
Token cost estimation and budget enforcement
Prompt quality checks: vagueness, verbosity, structure, role clarity
Auto-fix: removes politeness filler, redundant phrases, and injection patterns
Health score (0–100) with A–F grade across security, cost, quality, and completeness
GitHub Action with SARIF output and PR annotations
VS Code extension with inline diagnostics
Available as Python (pip) and Node.js (npm) packages
Zero network calls — all analysis runs locally
publicApiSurface: GitHub Action: AryaanSheth/promptlint@v1 (inputs: path, prompt, fail-level, config, show-score, sarif-output, annotations)
GitHub Action outputs: findings-count, critical-count, score, grade
